name: Oumagatoki no Kioku
source:
Main character heads mystery research club and loves walking around the school exploring various mysteries. It's not an official club, but student council turns a blind eye on it. One day hero gets caught in the middle of ridiculous incident because of exploring...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-january-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角领导着神秘研究社，喜欢在学校里四处走动，探索各种谜团。虽然这不是正式社团，但学生会对它睁一只眼闭一只眼。

一天，男主因为探索而被卷入了一场荒唐的事件……

[来自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-january-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
